account: In its project account, current as of June 2025, DP World reports that CargoWaves raised cargo throughput by 30% and lowered carbon dioxide per shipment by 20%. DP World also states that the platform lowers transport costs and cuts idle truck hours by 50%. An XGBoost classifier recommends haulers. DP World states that the time slot recommendations come from a weighted scoring rule that uses no machine learning. It also states that cargo owners used 15% of the recommendations from its recommendation systems to complete bookings. The account provides no independent audit. DP World does not separate the contribution of the AI from that of booking, paperless processing, and workflow integration.

ai_role.statement: AI recommends haulers and scheduling options. Digital booking, load coordination, paperless processing, and integration also contribute to the reported platform improvements.
